purpose: Independent exact-parity official replay of the frozen +1.5R Core action on the inherited high-volume accepted-delivery event.
logic: A completed high-volume one-hour close accepts price beyond the prior 96 completed-hour external boundary. The initial accepted-delivery position realizes the repeatable Core payoff at +1.5R while the inherited 2ATR stop and opposite prior-48h completed-channel state loss invalidate the same premise.

action.entry: completed one-hour decision plus fixed 500ms represented conservatively by first strictly later observed one-minute open
action.hard_stop: 2.0 x prior completed one-hour ATR20 from actual entry
action.target: +1.5R from actual entry and inherited stop distance
action.state_exit: first completed close through the opposite prior-48h channel, executed after the same latency

account.winner_deletion: delete the largest positive-PnL ceil(10% of selected entries) event keys before complete one-slot rerouting

source_authority.independent_reconstruction_requirement: 2022 and 2023 candidate counts, trade counts, NAV, PF, median, top-five concentration and 2023 exact winner deletion must reproduce before official evidence is accepted

prohibited_rescue: additional SMC checklist or ML filter
